extras: Requires the new file to have the exact same extension as the file being replaced.
intentEvidence: Easy File Replace solves this by letting you choose a new file from your operating system and transparently overwrite the original file's content while keeping its original name and path intact.
motivation: to let you effortlessly replace the contents of your vault's attachments without breaking any internal links.
problem: Updating an attachment requires manually deleting the old file, importing the new one, and renaming it to prevent broken links in Markdown.
summary: Easy File Replace allows users to replace the content of existing vault attachments with new files without breaking internal Markdown links.
